from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import json

# Data
labor_per_unit = [3, 2, 6]       # shirt, short-sleeve, casual
material_per_unit = [4, 3, 6]
selling_price = [120, 80, 180]
variable_cost = [60, 40, 80]
fixed_cost = [2000, 1500, 1000]
labor_avail = 1500
material_avail = 1600
n = 3

# Big-M values (upper bounds on production from resource constraints)
M = [labor_avail // labor_per_unit[i] for i in range(n)]  # [500, 750, 250]

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
x = [m.addVar(name=f"x_{i}", lb=0, ub=M[i], vtype="C") for i in range(n)]
y = [m.addVar(name=f"y_{i}", lb=0, ub=1, vtype="B") for i in range(n)]

# Labor constraint
m.addCons(quicksum(labor_per_unit[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)) <= labor_avail, "labor")

# Material constraint
m.addCons(quicksum(material_per_unit[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)) <= material_avail, "material")

# Link production to equipment usage (big-M)
for i in range(n):
    m.addCons(x[i] <= M[i] * y[i], f"link_{i}")

m.optimize()
